resources.string: Optional, off by default. Each switch lets a computer you paired and allowed on its side ask this phone for that data while the link is up. Switching it off stops sharing at once.
Share contacts
Read-only: names, numbers, emails for the Contacts app on your computer. Photos are never sent.
Share calendar
Read-only by default: events (with calendar, reminders and attendee names) from the calendars you tick, from 7 days back to 90 days ahead. Includes Google Calendar accounts that sync on this phone.
Let the computer edit my calendar

Off by default. Lets a paired computer you allowed add, change and delete one-off events in the calendars you ticked (never repeating events). Android asks for calendar write access only when you switch this on.

GeekBridge never signs in to Google. Edits are written to this phone\'s calendar and Google Calendar receives them through the phone\'s own sync. Remove the permission here or in Android settings to stop it at any time.

Share text messages (SMS)
Lets the computer list your SMS conversations, show new ones, and send a text through this phone.
Allow access
Short codes and premium numbers
Off: the computer cannot text numbers shorter than 7 digits or premium-rate ranges. They can cost money.

Android restricts SMS: reading and sending needs the SMS permissions (read, send, receive), and Google Play only allows them for the default messaging app. This build asks for them only when you switch this on. On Android 13+, an app installed outside a store may first need “Allow restricted settings” in its App info (⋮ menu). GeekBridge does not become your default messaging app. Not supported: MMS pictures, group texts, RCS chats. Message text goes only to your paired computer and is never logged.
